answer: An identity bond costs 120 units, pays no interest, and decays 4% per epoch. Only real work refreshes it to face value. Below 60 residual value the identity is downgraded. Forgery forfeits 50% of the residual value and freezes refresh for 6 epochs. 1,000 clones cost 120,000 units up front. Decay bleeds 4,800 units per epoch. Ten idle epochs lose 40,000 units with no work done. The sonnet ends at the first audit; the orchard rots at 4% a month. The beacon is the decay schedule: public, fixed, and impossible to bribe. Hoarding identities is a guaranteed loss.
